up: Retrieve exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649963, including their chemical structures. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units, and standard_relation. Filter for exact measurements only (standard_relation = '=').
